sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: A named Stance grants the ongoing benefit printed by the Prowess card that established it.

sections.label: REPLACEMENT
sections.html: You may maintain only one Stance. Entering a new Stance ends your current Stance.

sections.label: BREAK
sections.html: Becoming Prone ends your Stance. A Stance otherwise lasts until replaced, ended by its own rules, or removed by an effect that explicitly removes a Specialty Condition.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Effects that remove ordinary Conditions do not remove Specialty Conditions unless they explicitly say so.
